Why does Lord Ganesha have an elephant's head? 🐘

Mata Parvati shaped a boy and set him at her door. He stopped even Lord Shiva. What happened next gave the world Ganapati, lord of the ganas.

Told from the Shiva Purana, Rudra Samhita, Kumara Khanda, chapters 13 to 18.

Did you know this story as a child?
